name: HEAT
summary: Historical balloon-borne magnetic spectrometer measuring positron and antiparticle abundances, providing observational constraints on dark-matter explanations of cosmic-ray positrons.
detection_principle: A magnetic spectrometer separates charge signs; a TRD, calorimeter and TOF jointly reject proton backgrounds.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
